description: Calc .NET is an Excel compatible formula calculation engine for .NET. It recalculates every formula of a workbook and updates the cached cell values in place, so a spreadsheet produced or edited by your code carries the same results Excel would show. It handles cross sheet references, defined names, structured table references, shared and array formulas, dynamic array spilling and more than 490 Excel worksheet functions, for Microsoft Excel (.xlsx, .xls) as well as OpenDocument (.ods) documents. Calc .NET is self contained: it includes the entire Spreadsheet .NET library and the entire ODF .NET library, so no other component is needed to read, create, modify, calculate and save a document. The library does not require Microsoft Excel or any other third party application to be installed.
